profile.headline: Full Stack Engineer (React, NodeJS) | React | NodeJS | Javascript | Typescript | Amazon Bedrock |  RAG
profile.summary:
- About 3+ years of extensive experience with Object Oriented Programming and Ruby on Rails in developing web based applications.
- Strong debugging and problem-solving skills with an excellent understanding of system development methodologies, techniques, and tools.
- Experience in MVC Model View Controller architecture and frameworks.
- Developed multiple REST API as per client requirement.
- Having experience of Web Application development using Ruby on Rails, CSS, HTML, JavaScript, JQuery, and MySQL on Mac and Linux platform.
- Worked with different relational databases like MySql, Oracle, PostgreSQL.
- Experience with Test-Driven Development(TDD) and Behavioral Driven Development (BDD) using RSpec and Cucumber.
- Involved in gathering user requirements, system analysis, design, development, testing, and implementation.
- Exceptional ability to quickly master new concepts and capable of working in-group as well as independently.
- Strong Communication and Leadership skills.
- Familiar with different Software development methodologies like Agile and Waterfall.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Ann Arbor, Michigan, United States · Remote

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Designed Front-End application using Rails 4.0, CSS3, HTML5, Javascript, and jQuery.
- Implemented and enhanced CRUD operations for various Ruby on Rails based applications using the MVC (Model View Controller) architecture.
- Worked in Test-Driven Development (TDD) with Agile development methodology in a 2 weeks of iteration.
- Used RSpec and Cucumber for various Unit and Feature Testing.
- Worked with RVM, bundler, Ruby gems, and Libraries of Rails framework.
- Performed Database Designing, migration using Active Records with MySQL Database.
- Worked with various Email Delivery Services like Send-Grid for sending email notifications.
- Used PhantomJS(headless browser) and Selenium with Capybara for website scrapping.
- Provide ongoing management, production support and sustaining oversight for developed various web applications.
- Managed code versioning with Bitbucket and took part in various pull request code reviews.
- Managed deployment in various Environment including QA, Staging and Production.
- Used Swagger tool for API documentation.

positions.title: Graduate Student Assistant
positions.description: My responsibility to check whether the source code is fulfill required algorithm which is needed to implement the given task.Then after I need to compile and run the java programs which were submitted by students and need to grade them according to the grading policy.

projects.title: HungryChiu
projects.description: HungryChiu is kid’s game. It is similar to Tamagotchi. You have to feed the bird once it will become hungry.

projects.title: QR Recognizer
projects.description:
QR Recognizer is project which is designed to recognize the QR Code. The QR is higher version of Bar Code.This is Mobile Application made for Symbian OS. User scan the QR code and retrive the encoded data from it. This encoded data may contain Personal Information, URL, messages etc. User can also store the retrival data for future use.

Technology: J2ME, mySQL.
Responsibility: Designing and Coding.
